$comment: Read 8 Oct 2026 from ChartMasters' PUBLIC artist pages, not the Playcounts Tool (Paul: 'check chartmasters to update'). robots.txt was read first: 'User-agent: *' allows /artist/<slug>/ and disallows /spotify-streaming-numbers-tool/?, /wp-json/ and the query patterns; ClaudeBot, Claude-Web and anthropic-ai are blocked as training crawlers. Fetched with curl, no login, no cookies, no 'Request Update', no ?-URL of the tool, no AJAX endpoint. WHERE THE FIGURES ARE: each page's 'Streams Over Time' chart prints every month-end running total exactly, in the data-total attribute of its chart points (<circle class="cm-chart-point" data-month data-total>); the series is the Playcounts Tool's Total (lead + featured), proven by every 'September 2026' point equalling the Tool's 30 Sep total in reads/2026-10-02.json to the unit, and the 'October 2026' point is the newest total, month to date. The month-end series for all five is in 2026-10-08-series.json beside this file. THE DATE IS INFERRED, NOT PRINTED: the page prints no through-date for its newest point. Burna Boy, Tems, Asake and Tyla date to 5 Oct: CM's 2 Oct Tool total (reads/2026-10-04b.json) plus kworb's dailies for the days between leaves one ordinary day for the day kworb skipped (Burna 6,668,941; Tems 5,336,450; Asake 6,372,169) or a residual of 19,372 (Tyla); and @theowensblock's graphic labelled 5 Oct 2026 (a LEAD, not a source; the account labels its tables with ChartMasters' through-date, and its '1 Oct' table equals the Tool's 1 Oct read) prints Burna's and Tems' totals to the unit. WIZKID IS THE EXCEPTION: his page had already moved on to 11,889,076,613 (dated 6 Oct the same way) when read, so his 5 Oct total below, 11,882,989,347, is the one printed on that graphic, 634,667 above CM's 2 Oct Tool total plus kworb's three dailies. BEFORE MERGE: open the Playcounts Tool at valid_as_of=20261005, one tab per artist, and confirm 'Streams updated through October 5, 2026' and these five totals; any mismatch means this read does not apply. Pairs with kworb's pages stamped 2026/10/06 (N+1), the newest stamp all five share on 8 Oct 05:40 UTC.
